verdict.rationale: Supabase ships an official CLI (supabase init, supabase start) documented extensively for local development, migrations, and branching, and it also integrates AI-native tooling (MCP server, agent skills, plugins CLI) that AI agents can use alongside/via the CLI. Missing for 10: independent hands-on review specifically praising the CLI's AI-native workflow (only vendor docs and a probe confirm existence).
